rules.description: The portal must be opened for registration on 1st June 2017 for Pre‑Matric, Post‑Matric and Merit‑cum‑Means scholarship schemes for minorities.
rules.outcome: The portal becomes available for registration from that date.
rules.evidence_quote: The Portal will be opened for registration w.e.f. 1st June, 2017 for Pre-Matric, Post- Matric and Merit-cum-Means based scholarship schemes for minorities and the last date for submitting applications will be 31st August, 2017.

rules.description: Applications must be submitted by 31st August 2017.
rules.outcome: No applications will be accepted after that date.
rules.evidence_quote: The Portal will be opened for registration w.e.f. 1st June, 2017 for Pre-Matric, Post- Matric and Merit-cum-Means based scholarship schemes for minorities and the last date for submitting applications will be 31st August, 2017.

rules.description: All timelines must be strictly adhered to for timely disbursal of scholarships.
rules.evidence_quote: These timelines may be strictly adhered to for timely disbursal of scholarships.

rules.description: Extensions of timelines are normally not permitted and may only be granted under extraordinary circumstances.
rules.condition: When a request for a timeline extension is made.
rules.outcome: Extension will be denied unless extraordinary circumstances exist.
rules.evidence_quote: Extension of timelines will normally not be permitted, but done only under extra-ordinary circumstances as it will delay all subsequent processes.
